claim: Dense full-activation single-stream decode at the 3.3448 BPW coherent floor is bandwidth-walled at ~70 TPS (M3 Ultra peak) / ~40 TPS (current effective). 100 TPS is NOT reachable by kernel tuning alone at coherent density.

consequence_for_ladder.G20_40tps: dense-reachable: close the 471->819 bandwidth gap (fusion, fewer dispatches, better MLP kernel) OR run q3 near peak. Kernel work only.
consequence_for_ladder.G21_60tps: dense-reachable only near peak bandwidth (uniform-q4 @peak = 60.1). Tight; needs near-peak efficiency.
consequence_for_ladder.G22_100tps: NOT dense-reachable at coherent density. Requires breaking one invariant: (1) 471->819 effective bandwidth AND (2) one of: activation sparsity / conditional compute (skip near-zero SwiGLU neurons -> fewer active MLP bytes), multi-token amortization (G12 self-speculative / G11 Matryoshka: share the weight sweep over K accepted tokens; G12 primitive already measured 2.57x over 4 positions). Sub-2.44 BPW density is DEAD (below 3.3448 coherent floor).

levers_ranked: close bandwidth gap 471->819 GB/s (kernel/dispatch efficiency): 34.5 -> up to 60 TPS dense
activation sparsity in SwiGLU MLP (67% of active bytes): skip near-zero gated neurons
multi-token amortization G11/G12: only path to break the per-token weight-sweep wall for 100 TPS
caution: Q80 collapsed a supposed roof once; this wall is grounded in measured active_bytes + measured effective bandwidth, and it names the three escape hatches rather than declaring impossibility. Verify any TPS>70-at-coherent-density claim against active_bytes and whether all weights were actually touched.
